entries.d878354fae15a9f3: The company has formulated a 3-year medium-term management plan starting from the fiscal year ended January 2026, with the slogan “Adding color and joy to everyday life,” and aims to improve earnings power on two pillars, apparel and lifestyle, toward the realization of its long-term vision, “Opening new possibilities for lifestyles with the power of fashion.” In apparel wholesale, the company plans to expand sales to specialty stores, strengthen the functional fashion line Cross Function, and develop men’s products as a growth pillar; in retail, it plans to expand sundries shops and raise the share of sundries in apparel stores, and to expand ＥＣ sales through stronger promotion using SNS and live commerce. In lifestyle wholesale, the company plans to launch a new nail brand in the beauty field and develop new products such as recovery wear in the healthcare field, in addition to its seasonal sundries brand “Yoki.”
